participation.context: Played Egeon, and did not cross the water.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the title and your side. You played. You read the Rose's bill and stayed.

participation.context: Heard Mistress Vernon named, and would not add to it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought the groom's talk, and stopped when he had said it.
participation.name: George Bryan

participation.context: Would not have the name written down, or said twice.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

relations.quote: Mistress Vernon. With too much familiarity, the groom says, and the court says so.

story.body: You let Bryan say the name once. You refused a better sentence. You went back to finish Egeon.
